requirements.text: We're working with a leading foundational AI lab to find experienced data scientists and ML engineers who can help train their latest language model on data science documentation tasks. We're looking for practitioners with 4+ years of experience to review and assess documents - judging whether the content and structure of each reflect the material they would genuinely encounter in day-to-day data science practice.
